commands.name: $(play) Dev
commands.tooltip: Start the web app at http://localhost:3000 (pnpm dev)

commands.name: $(checklist) Lint
commands.tooltip: Run ESLint on the web app; warnings fail (pnpm lint)

commands.name: $(symbol-class) Types
commands.tooltip: Type-check the web app with tsc (pnpm typecheck)

commands.name: $(beaker) Test
commands.tooltip: Run the Vitest unit tests; no database needed (pnpm test)

commands.name: $(browser) E2E
commands.tooltip: Run the Playwright end-to-end tests on desktop and mobile (pnpm test:e2e)

commands.name: $(database) DB Start
commands.tooltip: Start the local Supabase database in Docker; run this first (pnpm db:start)

commands.name: $(refresh) DB Reset
commands.tooltip: Rebuild the local database from migrations and seed data; erases local changes (pnpm db:reset)

commands.name: $(beaker) DB Test
commands.tooltip: Run the database tests (RLS, constraints) and the double-booking concurrency test (pnpm db:test)

commands.name: $(debug-stop) DB Stop
commands.tooltip: Stop the local Supabase containers; data is kept (pnpm db:stop)
